research.title: Baseline Classification of Surface Defects in Inspection Images
bullets: Prepared inspection images by checking defect labels, removing duplicate frames, and organizing training and evaluation partitions by source object.
Implemented histogram of oriented gradients features with a linear classifier, then reviewed confusion matrices and misclassified examples under varying illumination.

research.title: Foreground Segmentation in Fixed-Camera Scenes
bullets: Prepared fixed-camera image sequences and foreground masks, checking annotation alignment and separating evaluation sequences from training footage.
Implemented a background subtraction baseline with morphological cleanup, evaluating mask overlap and reviewing errors caused by shadows and intermittent motion.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded discrepancies, and routed missing or damaged items to the appropriate staff.
Organized order paperwork, maintained stockroom labels, and prepared handover notes covering pending shipments and unresolved inventory discrepancies.

projects.title: Visual Word Baseline for Scene Classification
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using local image descriptors, clustering to construct a visual vocabulary, and linear classification.
Compared vocabulary settings on a held-out validation split and inspected confusion patterns among scenes with similar textures.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Image Retrieval
bullets: Implemented image retrieval using normalized color histograms and nearest-neighbor ranking, with consistent resizing and color conversion during preprocessing.
Evaluated retrieval rankings against category labels and inspected mismatches involving similar colors but different object shapes or backgrounds.
